results.title: In 2015, YouTubers built an RC plane with a giant circular wing; other pilots then flew smaller planes through its opening
results.description: Flite Test unveiled the Super Circle Plane, a remarkable annular-wing aircraft made from foam board with a striking circular cutout in its main wing. This design turned it into a dynamic target for other radio-controlled pilots, who competed to fly their smaller planes through the moving opening. The project created an exciting aerial challenge for festival-goers, ultimately showcasing its creativity and design despite a dramatic crash.
